operation_rules: Collect observed links from main content, then gather links revealed by at most six scroll actions before saving. Save only unique public .go.jp HTTP(S) pages; skip PDFs. Saving is capped at three and occurs after link collection because save navigates to the detail page.
assumptions: Listing pages expose public content links inside main sections; scroll may reveal additional links.
limitations: No runtime execution or unseen-page observation was available. Results depend on the selector and links returned by the supplied API.
